svg.title: The 7 multi-agent workflows
svg.desc: critic-panel in detail (lens fan-out, or one all-lens reviewer for a code-only round, dedup, a separate skeptic per blocker and per important finding up to the cap, the matrix, completion and TRACE records), and the other six workflows: scan-docs, gap-analysis, e2e-design, loop-iteration, improve-skills and trace-bench, with the model-tier legend.
svg.text: node = subagent with its own context · every checker returns a typed TRACE verdict
Clean only when completion is accept: no lens failed, no blocker confirmed, deferred or revised.
Unchanged prior verdicts are reused on an identical tree (treeId) instead of re-verified.
/loop at L2/L3 · items from pnpm trace plan-items
the Lead applies and CLEARs, never the maker
